topic: Photo Abstract Poster Generator multilingual landing page
modelInstruction: Use browser-side Canvas composition based on the Photo Abstract Editorial skill. The user uploads one image; the tool preserves the photo area and locally draws the abstract panel, title, and selected output ratio without remote image generation.
releaseBoundary: Public landing-page candidate includes root and localized routes, localized source data, SEO Factory locale records, sitemap coverage, language switch support, navigation, footer, AI Tools Hub card, homepage entries, local-code composition tool wiring, page-owned WebP demo assets, and targeted contract tests. Production deploy, commit, push, and R2 asset migration remain excluded until explicitly approved and credentials are available.
notes: Functional top tool uses a page-owned browser Canvas component instead of a shared image-generation model component.
Prompt input is intentionally absent; the page is scoped to one uploaded image and automatic Photo Abstract Editorial local composition.

Aspect ratio defaults to Auto because the skill asks the final composition to follow the uploaded photo and panel balance; fixed 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, and 16:9 canvas ratios are available when the outer shape matters.
